n9dccdf1469.headline: Palestinian economy suffers worst-ever collapse after Israel-Hamas conflict, UN says
n9dccdf1469.summary: A UN report said the two-year Gaza war and economic restrictions caused an unprecedented collapse in the Palestinian economy, wiping out decades of growth. Infrastructure and productive assets suffered extensive damage.
n9dccdf1469.why: The Palestinian economy depends heavily on aid, trade access and labour flows, so conflict and movement restrictions shape its growth and fiscal position.

n63ee10f5b1.headline: African trade set for digital revolution with new infrastructure launch
n63ee10f5b1.summary: AfCFTA, with the Tony Blair Institute, IOTA Foundation and World Economic Forum, launched Adapt, a digital trade platform. It aims to modernise African trade, reduce costs and unlock billions in economic gains.
n63ee10f5b1.why: The African Continental Free Trade Area is an intergovernmental pact to reduce tariffs and barriers across Africa, so digital trade tools affect cross-border commerce costs.

n7562156def.headline: The European Union votes to deepen defense industry ties with Ukraine
n7562156def.summary: EU lawmakers voted to deepen integration of the bloc's defence industry with Ukraine. The move comes as a U.S. peace plan remains in flux and Russia's unconventional warfare rattles the 27-nation bloc.
n7562156def.why: Defence procurement and industrial policy shape demand for arms makers and the allocation of EU public spending.

n6393c921e8.headline: Bank shares rise after reports they will be spared tax hike amid growth mission
n6393c921e8.summary: Bank shares rose after reports that banks would be spared a tax hike. Banks had been thought to face a potential increase to the bank levy as part of growth measures.
n6393c921e8.why: UK banks are sensitive to changes in the bank levy, a tax on bank balance sheets, which affects their profitability and capital returns.
n6393c921e8.why_moved: Reports that banks will be spared a potential increase to the bank levy lifted bank shares.

nb4f6c8e148.headline: Finance Ministry backs new plan to regulate Israel’s rental market
nb4f6c8e148.summary: The Finance Ministry expressed support for a national framework to expand rental housing, a policy shift from earlier backing cuts to long-term rentals. Officials say it is part of efforts to lower housing costs.
nb4f6c8e148.why: Rental market rules affect housing supply and costs, which feed into household spending and the wider economy.

n0bda562916.headline: Economy to contract 11-13 per cent Oct-Dec — PIOJ - Jamaica Observer
n0bda562916.summary: Jamaica's economy is expected to contract by as much as 13% in the October-December quarter following Hurricane Melissa, according to preliminary Planning Institute of Jamaica estimates.
n0bda562916.why: A sharp GDP contraction affects government revenue, borrowing needs and the outlook for Jamaican sovereign debt and investment.

n66ab915436.headline: ‘Madness’ to increase welfare spending in Budget, says AO World boss
n66ab915436.summary: AO World chief executive John Roberts urged the Chancellor to cut spending and make difficult decisions. He called a welfare spending increase in the Budget 'madness'.
n66ab915436.why: AO World is a UK online electricals retailer, and UK fiscal policy affects consumer spending and the wider retail outlook.

nddb10f9bb3.headline: We're shopping our feelings this Black Friday. Here are 3 things to know
nddb10f9bb3.summary: Signs point to deeper discounts this Black Friday as stores try to coax anxious shoppers into spending. The report outlines three things shoppers should know.
nddb10f9bb3.why: Black Friday is a key holiday sales period for US retailers, and consumer spending is a major driver of the US economy.

na52f86405c.headline: Botswana business confidence declines
na52f86405c.summary: A Bank of Botswana survey shows a significant decline in business confidence in the fourth quarter of 2025. The fall is attributed to a fragile economy and lower government spending.
na52f86405c.why: Business confidence surveys are leading indicators of investment and hiring, which matter for lenders and investors in Botswana's economy.

n2b9762eafa.headline: OK Zimbabwe cries foul, pleads with Harare City Council to evict informal competitors
n2b9762eafa.summary: Zimbabwe Stock Exchange-listed retailer OK Zimbabwe has asked the City of Harare for support as it faces mounting operational and financial pressures, including illegal traders in front of its outlets.
n2b9762eafa.why: OK Zimbabwe is a listed retail chain, and its performance is a bellwether for consumer spending in Zimbabwe.

n59839702b0.headline: UAE fuel rates: Will petrol prices drop in December?
n59839702b0.summary: The UAE reduced fuel prices for November by around 14-15 fils per litre. Residents are asking whether petrol prices will fall further in December.
n59839702b0.why: Domestic fuel prices in the UAE are set monthly and reflect movements in global oil prices.

n86da78b147.headline: European Union votes to deepen defence industry ties with Ukraine
n86da78b147.summary: European Union members voted to approve a 1.5-billion-euro programme to deepen defence industry ties with Ukraine. The vote deepens cooperation between EU and Ukrainian defence sectors.
n86da78b147.why: Defence spending and procurement are a growing area of industrial investment in Europe. Joint programmes affect contracts for European defence manufacturers.

n625dec7496.headline: Mazatlán airport to receive 1.2B pesos as TAR expands service with 5 new routes
n625dec7496.summary: Mazatlán International Airport in Sinaloa will receive over 1.2 billion pesos between 2026 and 2030 for major improvements and expansion, alongside five new routes by TAR.
n625dec7496.why: Airport capital programs expand passenger capacity and route networks, which drive tourism and regional trade.

n395991ef74.headline: Giorgetti hails EU green light for DPB, on right track - Business - Ansa.it
n395991ef74.summary: Italian Economy Minister Giancarlo Giorgetti welcomed the European Commission's approval of Italy's Public Budget Plan, the basis for the 2026 budget bill. He said Rome was on the right track.
n395991ef74.why: The European Commission assesses national budget plans under EU fiscal rules, and approval affects investor confidence in Italian public finances. Italy is one of the euro zone's largest sovereign debt issuers.

n693a013cb5.headline: Record £4.6bn in property insurance payouts made this year, figures show
n693a013cb5.summary: UK property insurers have paid a record £4.6bn in claims this year, according to figures from the Association of British Insurers. Bad weather accounted for around a fifth of the value of property claims.
n693a013cb5.why: Insurance claims levels affect insurers' underwriting results and pricing, and reflect the financial cost of extreme weather.

nfdf19caba0.headline: Elauwit Connection, Inc. Announces Closing of the Underwriter’s Partial Exercise of its Over-Allotment Option in Connection with its Initial Public Offering
nfdf19caba0.summary: Elauwit Connection, Inc. (NASDAQ: ELWT) announced the closing of the underwriter's partial exercise of its over-allotment option tied to its initial public offering. The company is a national managed services provider.
nfdf19caba0.why: The over-allotment option, or greenshoe, lets underwriters sell additional shares if demand is strong, adding to the total capital raised in an IPO.

n7bb4374948.headline: No more big cheques: UAE tenants can now pay rent monthly
n7bb4374948.summary: Tenants in the UAE increasingly want to avoid large upfront cheques, and landlords are accepting digital, predictable monthly rent payments. Experts say demand for the change is growing.
n7bb4374948.why: Rental payment terms affect tenant cash flow and the property-management and fintech services that handle rent collection.

n23af620353.headline: Revolut completes share sale, achieves $75bn in valuation
n23af620353.summary: Revolut completed a share sale that values the fintech at $75bn. The fundraising was led by Coatue, Greenoaks, Dragoneer and Fidelity Management & Research Company.
n23af620353.why: Revolut is a UK-based digital bank and fintech whose funding rounds and valuation are closely watched as a benchmark for private fintech investment.

n878faaa5c4.headline: Nearly 20 lakh jobs lost in 2023-24 in Bangladesh, another 8 lakh decline expected by this year: WB
n878faaa5c4.summary: The World Bank estimates Bangladesh lost nearly 2 million jobs in 2023-24, with another 800,000 decline expected this year. Women and youth were the hardest hit, the lender said.
n878faaa5c4.why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender that publishes economic assessments of developing countries. Labour-market losses affect consumer demand, the garment sector and the country's credit risk profile.

nde771711d9.headline: What PA’s $50.1 Billion Budget Does for Rural Hospitals, Communities
nde771711d9.summary: Pennsylvania's $50.1 billion state budget maintains prior spending on rural hospitals and increases Medicaid programs. Advocates say it does not resolve all challenges to accessing care.
nde771711d9.why: State budgets set spending on health care, infrastructure and public services, and they affect hospital finances and local economies.

n43e81639fc.headline: Australian home prices set for 6–10% rise in 2026: SQM Research
n43e81639fc.summary: SQM Research expects Australian home prices to rise 6–10% in 2026, with a mixed economy shaping the outlook and resilient cities leading gains.
n43e81639fc.why: Housing is a major part of Australia's household wealth and banking lending, so price trends influence consumer spending and bank loan books.

n8a5f903785.headline: PM Modi to virtually inaugurate Safran’s LEAP engine MRO facility in Hyderabad on Wednesday
n8a5f903785.summary: Prime Minister Modi will virtually inaugurate Safran's LEAP engine MRO facility in Hyderabad on Wednesday. It is the first such facility set up in India by a global engine OEM.
n8a5f903785.why: Safran is a French aerospace group whose CFM LEAP engines power many narrow-body jets, so local maintenance capacity matters for airline and supplier economics.

n1c17d570a8.headline: Eurostoxx futures -0.2% in early European trading
n1c17d570a8.summary: Eurostoxx futures fell 0.2% in early European trading, with investors taking a more tentative stance after a mixed session the previous day.
n1c17d570a8.why: The Euro Stoxx 50 tracks the largest blue-chip companies in the eurozone, so its moves signal broad sentiment across European equities.

naf51107b6f.headline: 62m at risk as Bangladesh’s poverty fight slows since 2016, says World Bank
naf51107b6f.summary: The World Bank said 62 million people in Bangladesh are at risk as poverty reduction has slowed since 2016, with urban factory jobs not growing as expected.
naf51107b6f.why: Bangladesh is a major garment exporter, and slowing job creation in manufacturing affects its growth outlook and labour market.

n63a0ce9729.headline: Norway wins European approval for floating offshore wind grant
n63a0ce9729.summary: Norway has won European approval for a grant supporting floating offshore wind projects, according to Windpower Monthly.
n63a0ce9729.why: Floating offshore wind is an emerging segment of renewable energy that uses deep-water technology. State grants can determine whether projects proceed and attract private investment.

na3143e1989.headline: India poised to cross the $4 trillion GDP mark this fiscal: CEA Nageswaran
na3143e1989.summary: India's Chief Economic Adviser V. Anantha Nageswaran said the country is on track to exceed $4 trillion in nominal GDP during the current fiscal year.
na3143e1989.why: Nominal GDP size affects India's global economic weighting, tax base and debt ratios, which matter for investors allocating to Indian assets.

n17196b681a.headline: What are the main events for today?
n17196b681a.summary: Upcoming September US retail sales and producer price index data are on the agenda, with the weekly ADP employment report also in focus for investors.
n17196b681a.why: Retail sales and producer prices are key gauges of US consumer demand and inflation, which shape Federal Reserve policy expectations.

n42a1006aa1.headline: Gold Jumps To ₹1.28 Lakh Per 10 Grams In Delhi, Strong Festive & Wedding Demand Lifts Prices Sharply
n42a1006aa1.summary: Gold in Delhi surged to Rs 1,28,900 per 10 grams and silver rose to Rs 1,60,800 per kg, driven by wedding-season demand and a weaker US dollar. Global prices dipped slightly.
n42a1006aa1.why: India is one of the largest gold consumers globally, so domestic demand and the rupee price of gold reflect both local buying and global bullion prices.

impacts.why: Domestic gold prices in Delhi rose on strong demand even though global prices dipped slightly.

impacts.why: Domestic silver prices in Delhi also jumped, per the input.

nb9febe5ed8.headline: PM Modi to inaugurate Safran’s India facility, unveil Skyroot’s 1st orbital rocket
nb9febe5ed8.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to inaugurate Safran Aircraft Engine Services' India facility and unveil Skyroot's first orbital rocket this week, the PMO said.
nb9febe5ed8.why: Safran is a French aerospace and engine group, and Skyroot is an Indian space startup. Their India activities relate to the growth of aviation and space manufacturing.

n300f3b6b8f.headline: Debt owed to City Hall has risen $1 billion during Brandon Johnson's term, money his budget could use
n300f3b6b8f.summary: Unpaid bills owed to the city of Chicago now exceed $8 billion, up $1 billion during Mayor Brandon Johnson's term. The administration plans to expand collections in a tough budget year.
n300f3b6b8f.why: Uncollected municipal receivables affect city revenue and budget capacity, which in turn influence municipal bond credit assessments.

n5a099b0e63.headline: Beijing Unveils Supercritical CO2 Turbine That Could Upend Power Tech
n5a099b0e63.summary: A compact supercritical CO2 turbine unveiled in Beijing could support carbon capture by using CO2 to generate energy. It could potentially lower emissions and storage costs.
n5a099b0e63.why: Power generation technology and carbon capture costs affect the economics of energy producers and the decarbonisation investment case.

nf6b5e8dd0e.headline: Singapore and Malaysia reaffirm commitment to setting effective frameworks for JS-SEZ
nf6b5e8dd0e.summary: Singapore and Malaysia have reaffirmed their commitment to effective frameworks for the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone. The aim is to support economic integration between the two countries.
nf6b5e8dd0e.why: The Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone is a cross-border initiative designed to attract investment and integrate supply chains between the two neighbours. Its frameworks shape investor access and regulatory treatment.

na622ea6a7c.headline: Flying blind on a dovish wing
na622ea6a7c.summary: A risk-on rally was spurred by a sudden shift in US rate-cut bets after dovish comments from policymakers, though it may falter in the coming sessions.
na622ea6a7c.why: The S&P 500 is the benchmark for large US companies, and expectations about Federal Reserve rate cuts strongly influence equity valuations and risk appetite.
na622ea6a7c.why_moved: Dovish comments from policymakers shifted US rate-cut expectations, spurring a risk-on rally in markets.

n08ddef17da.headline: Brussels is done being the world’s digital policeman
n08ddef17da.summary: A POLITICO analysis argues the 'Brussels Effect' of EU tech regulation is over and that Washington is now setting the pace on deregulation in Europe.
n08ddef17da.why: EU digital rules govern how large technology platforms operate in Europe, and changes to them affect compliance costs and competition for major tech firms.

nfe5a4bdfed.headline: Oil falls as Ukraine signals support for framework of Russia peace deal
nfe5a4bdfed.summary: Oil prices settled more than 1% lower on Tuesday after Ukraine hinted that a U.S.-led diplomatic push to end Russia's war could be yielding progress. The article says an end to the war could affect supply.
nfe5a4bdfed.why: Russia is a major oil exporter, so expectations of a peace deal and possible easing of sanctions weigh on crude prices through supply expectations.
nfe5a4bdfed.why_moved: Ukraine signalled support for a framework of a Russia peace deal after a U.S. diplomatic push, which reduced supply-risk premiums in oil.

n92aa1abde7.headline: Alliance Bank records higher 2Q earnings on loans growth, higher fee income
n92aa1abde7.summary: Alliance Bank Malaysia recorded another quarter of earnings growth in the three months to September 30, 2025, driven by loan growth and higher non-interest income.
n92aa1abde7.why: Alliance Bank is a Malaysian commercial bank whose earnings depend on lending volumes and fee income. Its results indicate conditions in the Malaysian banking sector.

n289f613373.headline: Bursa Malaysia sinks at midday despite revived rate cut hopes
n289f613373.summary: Malaysia's stock index gave up early gains in Kuala Lumpur even as regional markets rallied on revived expectations of a US rate cut in December.
n289f613373.why: Bursa Malaysia is the stock exchange for Malaysia's main equity benchmark, and regional equities often track US interest-rate expectations.

n37186a85e9.headline: Gilead snaps up Sprint’s TREX1 immunotherapy programme for $400m
n37186a85e9.summary: Gilead has acquired Sprint's TREX1 immunotherapy programme for $400 million. The asset targets the TREX1 protein, described as a novel target in oncology.
n37186a85e9.why: Gilead Sciences is a US biopharmaceutical company focused on antiviral and oncology therapies, and bolt-on deals shape its pipeline.

n5306c6df3e.headline: A look at previous failed pipeline projects in Canada
n5306c6df3e.summary: Alberta's push for a new oil pipeline has revived attention on three earlier failed pipeline projects in Canada, as the province seeks a new route for its crude.
n5306c6df3e.why: Pipeline capacity determines how Canadian crude reaches export markets, which affects producer prices and the Western Canada Select discount.

nbe74e39d3f.headline: Iceland Producer Price Inflation Eases To 3.0%
nbe74e39d3f.summary: Iceland's industrial producer price inflation softened slightly in October, with the producer price index rising 3.0% year on year after a smaller prior gain.
nbe74e39d3f.why: Producer price inflation is an early indicator of consumer inflation, which informs the Central Bank of Iceland's interest-rate decisions.

nfbac7b2952.headline: Coliwoo reports 75.1% fall in H2 net profit to S$5.7 million
nfbac7b2952.summary: Coliwoo reported a 75.1% fall in second-half net profit to S$5.7 million. The group declared a final dividend of S$0.02 per share.
nfbac7b2952.why: Coliwoo is a Singapore-listed company whose results and dividend policy inform investors on its profitability and shareholder returns.

n19da5d25f1.headline: Emirates and Air Canada extend partnership
n19da5d25f1.summary: Emirates and Air Canada have signalled a commitment to extend their strategic partnership, which began in 2022. The airlines say they have served more than 550,000 customers across 56 codeshare routes.
n19da5d25f1.why: Emirates is Dubai's flagship airline and Air Canada is Canada's largest carrier, so their codeshare alliance affects route networks and connectivity between the two regions.

n20e2427506.headline: Eby tells Carney it was ‘unacceptable’ for B.C. to be excluded in proposed pipeline talks
n20e2427506.summary: B.C. Premier David Eby told Prime Minister Carney it was unacceptable for B.C. to be excluded from proposed pipeline talks. He wants any Alberta-federal energy deal to cap or ban taxpayer funding for the pipeline.
n20e2427506.why: Pipeline projects carry large capital costs and regulatory risk, and how they are financed and who is consulted shapes their timing and viability.
